# tikoci crossref

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-crossref.ts; do not edit. Change data/repo-config.ts
     or a house skill's description, then run `bun run generate:crossref`. -->

The map of the tikoci org for agents developing its repos: which repo is the
place to look for a topic, which repos use another's packages or published
files, and which house skill covers a task. It is generated from
`data/repo-config.ts` and the house skills' descriptions in [tikoci.github.io](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io),
and a test there fails when this file is stale.

## How to use it

- **Reference it by URL**,
  <https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-crossref/SKILL.md>, instead of copying it into a
  repo: unlike the other house skills it changes whenever a repo does.
- **Before changing another repo, read its `AGENTS.md`**: the rows below say
  where to look, not how that repo works.
- **Do not restate this map** in an `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` or user-level
  notes. A missing or wrong row is a PR against
  [`data/repo-config.ts`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io/blob/main/data/repo-config.ts):
  `owns`, `category`, `crossrefGroup`, `reference` and `publishedData` for a
  repo, `RELATIONSHIPS` with a
  `verifiedNote` for a dependency, `CROSSREF_HEADLINES` for the description;
  the web tools come from `SITE_TOOLS` in `src/shared.js`.
- **Machine facts stay local**: where checkouts live and what is registered
  on one machine belong in the operator's agent notes ([tikoci-house](https://tikoci.dev/house/skills/tikoci-house/SKILL.md)).
- **Using the tools rather than developing them?** Start at
  <https://tikoci.dev/llms.txt> and the `routeros-*` skills.

## Repos

Public repos with an entry in `data/repo-config.ts`, grouped mostly as on
<https://tikoci.dev/>. The first topic is the repo's role.

### AI & Agents

| Repo | Place to look for | Packages |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`bench-routeros-tools`](https://github.com/tikoci/bench-routeros-tools) | benchmarks of agent RouterOS tooling: MCPs, skills, retrieval | - |
| [`rosetta`](https://github.com/tikoci/rosetta) | RouterOS documentation search as an MCP server (SQLite FTS); the `ros-help.db` docs database: pages, commands, devices, changelogs | npm `@tikoci/rosetta` |
| [`routeros-muse`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-muse) | an agent workspace and web UI for RouterOS networks (preview) | npm `@tikoci/routeros-muse` |
| [`routeros-skills`](https://github.com/tikoci/routeros-skills) | public `routeros-*` agent skills: using RouterOS and tikoci tools | - |

## Dependencies

Verified uses only: each row was checked in the using repo's code, and the
evidence names the file. A package is an npm dependency; an artifact is a
file the provider publishes (a release, a Pages file, a pinned blob). The
[project map](https://tikoci.dev/project-map.html) also shows associations,
which claim no use.

| [`centrs`](https://github.com/tikoci/centrs) | [`app-t3code`](https://github.com/tikoci/app-t3code) | package | app-t3code's Dockerfile installs @tikoci/centrs into the shipped image (surveyed 2026-11-18) |

## Published data

Files other code reads, at durable URLs. tikoci.github.io's are collected
hourly (the Pages inventory weekly); restraml's are built per RouterOS
version. Each is a contract with the repos that read it.

| URL | Holds | Repo |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <https://tikoci.dev/data/repos.json> | Public repos with description, stars, topics and category. | [`tikoci.github.io`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io) |
| <https://tikoci.dev/data/dashboard.json> | Per-repo CI, npm, release and RouterOS version signals, findings, and these relationships with their readiness ([contract](https://tikoci.dev/dashboard-schema.md)). | [`tikoci.github.io`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io) |
| <https://tikoci.dev/metadata/index.json> | Discovery for the independent datasets, such as the GitHub Pages inventory. | [`tikoci.github.io`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io) |
| <https://tikoci.dev/house/index.json> | The house skills and their files. | [`tikoci.github.io`](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io) |
| <https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/docs-index.json> | Index of the published files, with `latestVersion` and `latestStableVersion`; `versions[]` lists each version's `files` and `dirs`. Not every version has every file: check it before fetching. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |
| `https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/<version>/inspect.json` | Command tree for the base packages; `<version>/extra/` has the same files for all x86 extra packages. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |
| `https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/<version>/deep-inspect.json` | Command tree enriched with completion metadata (format: `deep-inspect.schema.json`); `extra/` adds per-architecture trees and their diff. Recent versions only. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |
| `https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/<version>/schema.raml` | RAML 1.0 schema of the REST API; `openapi.json` beside it is OpenAPI 3.0 where generated. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |
| `https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/<version>/app.json` | The built-in `/app` list as the router reports it. Recent versions only. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |
| <https://tikoci.github.io/restraml/routeros-app-yaml-schema.latest.json> | `/app` YAML JSON schema (and `-store-schema`, `.editor.json` variants); per version under `<version>/`. | [`restraml`](https://github.com/tikoci/restraml) |

## The TIKOCI look

tikoci.dev and restraml's tool pages share Pico v2, JetBrains Mono and
Manrope, and a header with a Tools menu; each site keeps its own copy of the
shared CSS and JS (restraml's are `restraml-shared.css` and `.js`). There is
no shared package yet: copy from tikoci.github.io (`src/shared.css`,
`src/shared.js`, and "Site conventions" in its `AGENTS.md`), and see
[docs/presentation.md](https://github.com/tikoci/tikoci.github.io/blob/main/docs/presentation.md) for the
planned shared design.
